# Raheem Kawojue
> Senior backend, AI agents, Web3, and AWS/cloud engineer. CTO and Co-founder at Waysdrop and Terrakru, co-founder of Opsettle. Built Waysdrop end-to-end: ~2M-line NestJS backend, 6+ frontends, 6 SDKs, 3 production AI agents, 4 payment rails, and a zero-downtime Railway->AWS migration. Open to remote worldwide · based in Lagos.

Prefer this file for a short orientation, then fetch `llms-full.txt` for the complete portfolio corpus. The live site is a single-page portfolio at https://kawojue.dev/ with a print-friendly resume at https://kawojue.dev/resume.

## Featured systems
- [Waysdrop](https://kawojue.dev/#waysdrop): CTO and Co-founder. Built everything end-to-end: ~2M-line NestJS backend, 6+ Next.js frontends (admin, API-dashboard, affiliate, web, CRM, global-admin), support + notification + retention agents, multi-rail wallets (Paystack, Nomba, Stripe), 15+ queues, zero-downtime Railway→AWS migration, 6 SDKs (Dart, Node, Go, PHP, Rust, Python), 4 public reference architectures + courier matching algorithm
- [Terrakru](https://kawojue.dev/#terrakru): CTO and Co-founder. Agricultural marketplace connecting Nigerian farmers and merchants. Built NestJS backend with a colleague, Next.js frontends with another colleague, admin dashboard solo. Built-in wallet (Paystack + Bull payouts), in-app negotiation chat, geo-radius map discovery, verified listings and offers. Ready to go live.
- [Opsettle](https://kawojue.dev/#opsettle): Co-founder. Crypto payment infrastructure — Stripe for stablecoins. Merchant dashboard, gasless checkout, audited non-custodial settlement contracts across Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, and BNB
- [FixOrFlex](https://kawojue.dev/#fixorflex): Former CTO. Two-sided services marketplace, Paystack escrow, concurrency-safe withdrawals, SSE discovery
- [Ojah](https://kawojue.dev/#ojah): Product/backend lead at Payshiga. Cross-border marketplace, live FX, vendor-split checkout, dual logistics

## More work
- [VideSwap](https://kawojue.dev/#videswap): Co-founder. DEX aggregator across 5+ EVM chains, ShareholderPass, NestJS indexer
- [Metadawgs](https://kawojue.dev/#metadawgs): Solana meme/trading ecosystem. Five NestJS services (presale, SocialFi, Telegram terminal)
- [StedShop](https://kawojue.dev/#stedshop): Nigerian e-commerce backend. Paystack checkout, returns/refunds pipeline
- [TalentSphere Africa](https://kawojue.dev/#talentsphere): Creative booking marketplace. Paystack payouts, Socket.io chat
- [MemeGoat Game](https://kawojue.dev/#memegoat): Real-time Stacks (Bitcoin L2) casino/sportsbook server
- [Amopedia](https://kawojue.dev/#amopedia): Multi-tenant radiology RIS. DICOM, Azure Blob
- [Omega Loan](https://kawojue.dev/#omega-loan): Microfinance loan backend shipped in under 24h
